overview_description.description:
Vimmerse is an AI deep tech company that brings photos to life improving audience engagement and customers conversions. It serves customers the state-of-art AI to convert images into captivating videos via our creators platform, Apps, and API. It simplifies AI image editing and animation, reducing costs and time while eliminating the need for advanced design skills. Vimmerse also offers bulk processing, customization, and compute power, enhancing branding and consumer engagement at scale.

Vimmerse is headquartered in San Jose, California and was founded in 2021.
